title: Adaptogen Immunity Drops
body_html:
Adaptogen Immunity Drops deliver a blend of functional mushrooms traditionally valued for their role in supporting wellness and vitality. The proprietary mushroom immune complex features chaga, reishi, maitake, shiitake, and turkey tail — mushrooms recognized in traditional practices for helping support the body’s natural immune defenses. Combined with cordyceps mushroom extract, this carefully crafted formula is designed to complement a balanced lifestyle focused on resilience and everyday well-being.

Liquid drops offer a convenient alternative to capsules or tablets, allowing for quick and flexible use at home or on the go. Naturally sweetened with stevia, the formula has a pleasant taste without added sugar. This makes it easy to incorporate into your daily routine — take it directly or mix it into your favorite drink for a simple wellness boost.

Adaptogen Immunity Drops are ideal for active individuals and those navigating demanding lifestyles. Athletes, high-stress professionals, and people living in challenging climates often look for ways to support their daily immune wellness and overall balance. With its blend of functional mushrooms and adaptogenic ingredients, this formula offers a modern, convenient way to bring traditional mushroom support into your everyday routine.*


Ingredients: Proprietary Mushroom Immune Complex (Chaga, Reishi, Maitake, Shiitake, & Turkey Tail) (150 mg), Cordyceps Mushroom Extract (50 mg), Glycerin, Purified Water, Natural Flavoring, Sweetener (Stevia), Potassium Sorbate, Nisin.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/ml/lbs/g): 1 fl oz / 30 ml / 0.07 lbs / 30 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 3 oz / 0.19 lbs / 84 g
Suggested use: Shake well. Take 1 mLl(30 drops) daily.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
